rationale: Builds on the winning staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline with a compact, compile-stable training change: late in training, the loss is gradually reweighted toward the sequence tail that dominates doc-isolated sliding evaluation at stride 64. This targets the final exact int8+zlib metric directly, keeps shapes fixed, avoids extra export bytes, and preserves the existing recurrent-tail and quant-aware endgame.
title: Late Tail-Aligned Loss Curriculum
